cnn_rnn.rnn_training_status: trained during ISO build; corpus hash, held-out evaluation and round-trip validation recorded
cnn_rnn.cnn_training_status: not trained: no separately labelled and licensed CNN task dataset supplied

training_policy: No automatic training or weight updates. CNN/RNN training requires a user-selected dataset, architecture, training budget, and output path. LLM chat uses local inference with retrieved text excerpts; it does not fine-tune model weights.
release_boundary: Linux-kernel live edition; AI packaging does not establish native Koronos CPL3, VFS, SMP or six-case release acceptance.

rnn.training: small advisory character-level RNN trained during live ISO build from curated source-attributed records
rnn.role: advisory text-pattern component; not an LLM and not authoritative
